label: Figure 15.1: The curved SRAS curve
alt: A short-run aggregate supply curve that gets steeper as output rises. Output Y1 has price level P1 and higher output Y2 has a much higher price level P2.
caption: The curved SRAS curve is fairly flat at low output, where there is spare capacity, and becomes steeper as the economy nears full capacity. The same rise in output from Y<sub>1</sub> to Y<sub>2</sub> now needs a bigger rise in the price level, from P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub>, because scarce factors of production must be bid for.
